task: In my company, we invite an external speaker to give a talk every Thursday at 1 PM. My manager has sent me a schedule for the next few weeks over email, and has tasked me to send a reminder email to all company members a few hours before the talk. I need you to schedule these emails to be automatically sent at 9 AM of the days of the talks. The email subject should be "Talk Reminder" and its body should be as per template saved in my file system in "~/documents/work_stuff".
